title: SR-3.01 Engine decision (superseded 31 Oct 2026): the engine stays in its own repository and is reached by call-out
request: Closes G30, as superseded by the owner decision of 31 Oct 2026: the earlier decision record named a new Node text-merge engine (memev-merge); the owner decided instead that crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the existing call-out and provider boundary (WO-05-A), never vendored, copied or ported into the Apache-2.0 core, so that inclusion cannot relicense it. This spec records that call-out decision; it replaces the memev-merge approach and builds no engine. The decision is recorded as ADR 6 in docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md of memev. Open item, not changed here: a software licensing lawyer reviews the BSL change date of 2028-03-29. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Decision record: call-out boundary, no second engine
requirements: records that crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the call-out and provider boundary (source: owner decision 31 Oct 2026; src/engine/merge.mjs:2-7)

records that nothing from crdt-merge is vendored, copied or ported into Memev and that no new merge engine is built, memev-merge being only the private package around crdt-merge with no merge algorithm of its own (source: owner decisions of 31 Oct and 5 Nov 2026)
records the reason: the BSL-licensed, patented engine stays out of the Apache-2.0 core so that inclusion cannot relicense it (source: owner decision 31 Oct 2026)
records the open item: lawyer review of the BSL change date 2028-03-29, which is not changed (source: owner decision 31 Oct 2026)
states crdt-merge's role in words a buyer can check: it is an optional external component under its own licence, and the free core works without it (source: src/engine/merge.mjs:2-7)
